description: Ministry of Justic Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms- appointments Under the Prisons Ordinance Local Visiting Committees for a Period of three Yrars with effect from 22nd July 2024.
categorisation: This gazette contains appointments to Local Visiting Committees under the Prisons Ordinance. It specifically involves law enforcement/corrections administration by appointing members to prison oversight committees. While it mentions the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, this is only in his capacity as the appointing authority under the Prisons Ordinance. The core content is about prison administration and oversight committee appointments, which falls under Judicial/Law Enforcement matters (Type 9) rather than government personnel changes.
